matter_background.original:
Romani who intends to go to New Zealand wants to file a caveat to her property situated in Battaramulla and meets you who are a Notary practising in Colombo.

While the caveat is in force Romani is notified by the Registrar of Lands that a document affecting the land is presented for registration.
